## Deliverable
A ruling on the pre-series oracle stack retro (retire it, or run it), plus the alert wording fix for a label-less stale group.

## Acceptance
1. Seat rules: (a) oracle's stack-level retro is retired, so delete the Pushgateway group `job=retro-session,stack=oracle` (no `series` label); or (b) it should run, so re-fire it with `argo -n agent-coordinator submit --from cronworkflow/<oracle retro>`.
2. `RetroReportOverdue` no longer fires on the oracle group.
3. The `<none has ever pushed>` fallback in `argocd/resources/pushgateway/prometheusrule.yaml` (and the `retro-report.promtool-rules` copy) reads a label-less stale group as a stale push.

## Out of scope
The platform series (fresh; r10 landed 2026-11-02) and oracle's feedback-triage series (born suspended, homelab#3140).

Origin: dig finding dig-2026-11-04/dig-r1-20261104T033004Z/finding-1 (cause-found). Since homelab#3161 (2026-11-02) the rule is `max by (series)`, which exposes the oracle stack retro's last success of 2026-08-17 (last report PR #246). The alert has been firing since 2026-11-02 21:11Z, and this sitting re-verified it live on 2026-11-04.
